submitted.rationale: Across the line, EQE was highest on the Fe-rich side. It peaked at Sb≈0.16 (0.135%). Both neighbours were lower: Sb=0.12 gave 0.107% and Sb=0.27 gave 0.052%. Sb-rich compositions (0.49 and 0.72) were close to zero. The measured optimum is near 0.14–0.2 Sb, which is consistent with Fe2O3-based absorption at 2.4 eV being improved by a modest amount of Sb.
